Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Legendary video game artist Yoji Shinkawa returns to Magic for an entire Secret Lair drop! Play a menagerie of bio-mechanical monstrosities crafted in Shinkawa’s iconic ink and watercolor look, made even more special with an art-forward Borderless layout. Augment your collection or deck just the way you want—claim your copies in English or Japanese!

Contents:
• 1x Borderless Tezzeret the Seeker
• 1x Borderless Phyrexian Metamorph
• 1x Borderless Skullclamp
• 1x Borderless Solemn Simulacrum
